simple.meaning: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בַּת (H1323) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 590 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בַּת (bath) means a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 50.
